decision.message: Q0 failed. The privileged teachers are not clearly better than B1 on energy and the three macros. Stop. Do not keep distilling. Wait for Triste.

rules.q0: A teacher is clearly better than B1 on a nutrient when the plate-grouped 95% CI of (teacher - B1) lies entirely below 0 for both per-dish MAE and per-dish PMAE. Q0 passes only when the geometry teacher and the names-only ingredient teacher both clear that bar on energy, fat, carb, and protein. Mass is recorded and is not required.
rules.stable: Stably better means the plate-grouped 95% CI of (method - baseline) is strictly below 0 on both per-dish MAE and per-dish PMAE. Resamples draw physical plates, using dish_id unless a reshoot file groups ids. A CI that touches or crosses 0 is not a pass. Mass is not a pass condition.
